blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: On-policy distillation (OPD) is emerging as an important paradigm for language-model post-training, combining dense teacher supervision with training on student-generated trajectories. This creates a feedback loop where each update changes the student and thereby the training distribution that generates subsequent updates. Yet, how this feedback shapes learning and generalization remains poorly understood. We conduct a mechanistic analysis of OPD's learning dynamics, distinguishing the two feedback loop stages: conversion of the distillation signal into parameter updates, and broadcast through which these updates change predictions across prefixes and reshape the rollout distribution. This framework helps us understand both limited student responsiveness despite substantial teacher-student disagreement, and degeneration when updates that improve local teacher agreement also increase the probability of unsuccessful continuations, exposing the student to unreliable supervision in subsequent rollouts. Finally, we show that offline distillation can prepare a student for OPD without significantly improving immediate held-out accuracy. While OPD alone may degrade generation, it can yield substantial accuracy gains after sufficient offline preparation. Together, our results connect teacher supervision, student geometry, and the evolving rollout distribution in determining the learning dynamics of OPD and its effects on downstream performance.
blocks.zh: 政策蒸馏(OPD)正在成为语言模式后培训的重要范例,将密集的教师监督与学生生成的轨迹培训结合起来. 这创造了一个反馈循环,每次更新都会改变学生,从而产生后续更新的培训分布. 然而,这种反馈是如何形成学习和概括的,对此仍然认识不足。 我们对OPD的学习动态进行机械分析,区分两个反馈循环阶段:将蒸馏信号转换为参数更新,并通过这些广播更新跨前缀的变化预测并重塑推出分布. 这个框架帮助我们理解学生的反应有限,尽管师生意见大不相同,而且当更新改善当地教师协议也增加了不成功续办的可能性,使学生在随后的推广中面临不可靠的监督时,则会退化。 最后,我们显示,离线蒸馏可以让学生为OPD做好准备,而不会显著提高即时搁置的准确性。 虽然光是OPD就可能降解生成,但经过充分的离线准备后,它就能产生大量的精度增益. 我们的成果共同将教师监督、学生几何学以及不断演变的推广分布联系起来,以确定OPD的学习动态及其对下游业绩的影响。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: On-policy distillation (OPD) is becoming an important component of language-model post-training ( Lu and Thinking Machines Lab, 2025 ; Song and Zheng, 2026a ) . By matching a teacher’s next-token distributions at student-generated prefixes, it combines dense supervision with training on the states the student actually visits ( Gu et al., 2024 ; Agarwal et al., 2024 ) . Yet, how this local supervision becomes useful learning over an evolving training distribution remains insufficiently understood. It is therefore important to theoretically understand both the conditions under which OPD improves generalization and its role alongside offline distillation.
blocks.zh: 政策分解(OPD)正在成为语言模式后培训的重要组成部分(Lu and Thinking Machines Lab, 2025; Song and Zheng, 2026a.). 通过在学生产生的前缀上匹配教师的相邻分布,它将密集的监管与学生实际访问的状态培训结合起来(Gu等,2024;Agarwal等,2024)。 然而,这种地方监督如何成为对不断演变的培训分配的有益学习,仍然没有得到充分的理解。 因此,必须从理论上理解OPD改进通缩的条件及其在离线蒸馏的同时的作用。

blocks.en: The difficulty is that each OPD update changes both the student’s current behavior and the prefixes on which it will subsequently learn. Reducing teacher-student divergence on currently supervised predictions does not necessarily produce parameters from which further updates are useful ( Li et al., 2026b ; Armandpour et al., 2026 ) . Modelling this requires a view of how supervision changes behavior beyond the current batch and how that impacts learning at later stages. We conduct a mechanistic analysis, aided by a first-principles account, of OPD learning dynamics to study this process, explain existing empirical challenges, and justify their empirical diagnostics and fixes.
blocks.zh: 困难在于每个 OPD 更新既改变学生当前的行为,也改变学生随后学习的前缀. 减少师生对目前所监督的预测的分歧不一定产生一些参数,从中可以进一步更新(Li等,2026b;Armandpour等,2026). 建模这项工作需要了解监督如何改变当前批次之外的行为,以及在以后阶段如何影响学习。 我们在第一原则说明的协助下,对业务发展办公室的学习动态进行机械分析,以研究这一进程,解释现有的经验挑战,并证明其经验诊断和修正的合理性。

blocks.en: We first characterize how the teacher-student log-probability difference can lead to meaningful weight updates, which depends on the overlap between the distillation signal and the logit-space directions the student’s current parameters can express. We then describe how learning at one prefix affects predictions at future ones through their dependence on shared parameter directions. We formalize this broadcast relationship through the student’s tangent kernel between the two prefixes, building on Ren and Sutherland (2025) ; Malladi et al. (2023) . Finally, we connect each update to its effect on the outcomes of student-generated sequences. The effect of these updates in broader settings also depends on what the training data covers: matching the teacher on narrow tasks may transfer only the capabilities that those tasks exercise. Integrating these effects over training characterizes what OPD can reach from a given starting point, accounting for how much successive updates improve or degrade performance.
blocks.zh: 我们首先描述师生的对数概率差异如何导致有意义的重量更新,这取决于蒸馏信号和学生当前参数能够表达的对数空间方向之间的重叠。 然后,我们描述一个前缀的学习如何通过对共享参数方向的依赖影响未来的预测。 我们通过学生的正内核在Ren和Sutherland(2025年)的基础上, 最后,我们将每个更新与它对学生生成的序列结果的影响联系起来. 这些更新在更广泛的环境中的效果还取决于培训数据涵盖的内容:将老师匹配到狭义的任务上可能只转移这些任务所行使的能力. 将这些影响与培训相结合,是业务厅从一个特定起点可以达到的目标,说明连续更新如何改进或降低业绩。

blocks.en:
This framework helps us understand two primary failure modes of OPD: stagnation under stronger teachers and degeneration into incoherent outputs ( Li et al., 2026b ; Fu et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . In the first case, despite substantial teacher–student log-probability differences, we show that the initial distillation signal can induce smaller parameter gradients as training proceeds, contributing to stalled improvement. In the second case, updates that reduce teacher–student disagreement at supervised prefixes also change predictions at other prefixes through shared parameters. These changes can shift the rollout distribution toward continuations the student cannot execute reliably, making those unstable continuations the source of subsequent supervision, making the teacher struggle to rescue, let alone improve the student.
We illustrate the dynamical process of OPD and its possible failure modes in Figure 1 (we will elaborate on the intuitions behind this further in Section 3.1 ).
blocks.zh:
这个框架帮助我们理解OPD的两种主要失败模式:在更强的教师领导下停滞和退化成不连贯的产出(Li等,2026b;Fu等,2026;Wang等,2026). 第一种情况是,尽管师生的日志概率差异很大,但我们显示,初始分馏信号可以随着培训的进行而诱发较小的参数梯度,从而导致停滞不前的改进。 在第二种情况下,在监管前缀中减少师生分歧的更新也会通过共享参数改变其他前缀的预测. 这些变化可以将推广的分布转移到学生无法可靠执行的续作上,使这些不稳定的续作成为后续监督的来源,使教师为营救而奋斗,更不用说改善学生了.
我们将在图1中说明业务发展办公室的动态进程及其可能的失败模式(我们将在第3.1节中进一步阐述这方面的直觉)。

In principle, OPD propagates current teacher requests Γ t ​ ( s ) | s ∼ μ t \Gamma_{t}(s)|_{s\sim\mu_{t}} to motion at any future prefix x x through shared parameters, captured by the Neural Tangent Kernel K ⁡ ( x , s ) K(x,s) . Such policy motion shapes how the autoregressive rollout (prefix visitation) and supervision distribution changes ( μ ˙ t , Γ ˙ t \dot{\mu}_{t},\dot{\Gamma}_{t} ). In practice, a healthy dynamics needs not only locally “tangent-accessible” and coherent requests ( Section 3.2 ), but also the student to be sufficiently “prepared”, so that it can sustain meaningful rollouts with learning value as it absorbs corrections requested by the teacher, instead of primarily performing local mimicry and falling into chaotic rollouts hard for the teacher to rescue, let alone improve on ( Sections 3.3 and 3.4 ).

blocks.en: The dependence of OPD on the student sustaining stable rollouts (prefixes) which induce meaningful supervision motivates offline preparation. Here, the weak student is first forced to visit the teacher’s prefixes and learn predictions there, enabling the subsequent OPD process to sustain productive learning as the student exposes finer correction opportunities to the teacher, while maintaining stabler and more recoverable changes in its rollout distribution. Across Qwen-2.5 and Llama-3.1 models on AIME 2024 and 2025 problems, we find that under sufficient offline training, the subsequent OPD phase substantially improve pass@ k k (for k k up to 32) and per-problem reliability compared to offline training alone. In the rest of the paper, we present these results and insights organized under the following three questions. What determines the conversion of teacher supervision into policy motion ( Section 3.2 )? Does the broadcast of these updates across prefixes improve subsequent reasoning or steer the student toward unreliable continuations and supervision ( Section 3.3 )? Can offline preparation strengthen the student’s continuation ability and enable productive on-policy learning ( 3.4 )?
blocks.zh: 发展办公室依赖学生维持稳定的推广(前缀),从而诱发有意义的监督,这促使学生离线准备。 在这里,弱小的学生首先被迫访问教师的前缀,并在那里学习预测,使得随后的OPD进程能够持续生产性学习,因为学生向教师暴露出更精细的校正机会,同时在推广分配上保持更稳定和更可收回的变化. 在关于2024年和2025年问题的Quen-2.5和Llama-3.1型号上,我们发现,在足够的离线训练下,随后的OPD阶段大大改进了通过@ k k (对于k至32个)和每个问题的可靠性,而仅是离线训练。 在文件的其余部分,我们提出以下三个问题下的成果和见解。 是什么决定将教师监督转变为政策动议(第3.2节)? 通过前缀广播这些更新是否改进了随后的推理或引导学生走向不可靠的续作和监督(第3.3节)? 离线准备能否加强学生的继续学习能力并促成富有成效的政策学习(3.4)?

blocks.en: Related works . We briefly discuss related works here, and leave the expanded version to Appendix Appendix B . On-policy distillation. Training on learner-generated states with expert feedback is a classical approach to addressing distribution shift in imitation learning ( Ross et al., 2011 ) , applied to autoregressive distillation by Lin et al. (2020) . Gu et al. (2024) develop reverse-KL distillation using student rollouts, while Agarwal et al. (2024) unify on-policy and off-policy training across multiple divergences. Lu and Thinking Machines Lab (2025) demonstrate its effectiveness for reasoning and personalization in language-model post-training. More recently, Yang et al. (2026) interpret OPD as dense KL-constrained reinforcement learning and introduce reward extrapolation. Empirical studies identify teacher-student compatibility on student prefixes as important factors in transfer and training failure ( Li et al., 2026b ; Fu et al., 2026 ) .

(2024年)利用学生的推出来开发倒向-KL分馏,而Agarwal等人(2024年)则在多个分歧中统一了政策和非政策培训. 卢和想机实验室(2025年)在语言模型后培训中展现出其推理和个人化的有效性. 最近,杨等(2026年)将OPD解释为密集的KL限制强化学习并引入了奖励外推法. 实证研究将师生在学生前缀上的相容性确定为转移和培训失败的重要因素(李等,2026b;傅等,2026.).

blocks.en: Learning dynamics of finetuning. Kernel-based analyses connect parameter updates to changes in language-model predictions ( Malladi et al., 2023 ) . Ren and Sutherland (2025) decompose per-step prediction changes using the loss gradient and empirical tangent kernel, analyzing confidence dynamics in SFT and DPO ( Rafailov et al., 2024 ) . Tomihari (2026) study how RL updates propagate across examples, while Shen et al. (2026) identify persistent low-dimensional subspaces in OPD updates. Building on these perspectives, we connect the student’s evolving tangent kernel to its response to teacher supervision, the quality of its continuations, and the resulting distribution of future training prefixes. This distinguishes limited response to supervision from policy changes that worsen generation, and explains how either can shape subsequent learning.
blocks.zh: 学习微调动态. 基于克内尔的分析将参数更新与语言模型预测的变化联系起来(Malladi等,2023.). Ren和Sutherland (2025)利用损失梯度和实证正切内核分解出每步预测变化,分析SFT和DPO中的信心动态(Rafailov等,2024年). Tomihari (2026年)研究RL更新如何跨例传播,而Shen等人 (2026年)在OPD更新中识别出持久的低维子空间. 基于这些观点,我们把学生不断发展的切入内核与其对教师监管的反应、其延续的质量以及由此产生的未来培训前缀的分配联系起来。 这区分了对监督的有限反应和使一代人更加恶化的政策变化,并解释了两者如何形成后续学习。

blocks.en: 2 Setup
blocks.zh: 2 设置

blocks.en: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own samples. The student generates a continuation from a prompt. At every prefix of that continuation, the training loss pulls the student’s next-token distribution toward the next-token distribution of a fixed teacher ( Gu et al., 2024 ; Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Lu and Thinking Machines Lab, 2025 ) . This section fixes the notation for the objects that recur in the paper, including the policies, the source distribution that a run trains on, the request field that the teacher induces on that source, and the evaluation targets that we score runs against.
blocks.zh: 政策蒸馏(OPD)在自己的样本上训练一个学生. 学生从一个提示产生续作. 在续课的每一个前缀上,培训损失都将学生的接班分配推向固定教师的接班分配(Gu等人,2024年;Agarwal等人,2024年;Lu and Thinking Machines Lab,2025年)。 本节修正了纸上重现对象的标记,包括政策,运行中运行的源分布,老师在该源上所引出的请求字段,以及我们得分的对照评价目标.

blocks.en: Let us look at the illustrative process in Figure 1 . Intuitively, imagine that the earlier requests locally promote the student to reason more and in specific manners (for instance, by requesting more “wait”-based backtracking, suppressing early “Answer:” commitment, asking for a specific theorem, and so on). Due to the autoregressive nature of the policies, this will not only affect how likely the student emits specific tokens such as “wait” or “answer:” in a future rollout of the student, but will also alter the overall rollout distribution, by lengthening the reasoning trace, exposing new reasoning sub-trajectories, different errors, etc. In the benign case, such online dynamics can be beneficial, as the teacher can correct the student in real time as if in a “tutorial” session.
blocks.zh: 让我们看看图1中的说明性进程。 从直觉上,想象一下,早先的要求会促进学生以更具体的方式进行推理(例如,要求更多的基于“等待”的回溯跟踪,压制早期的“回答:”承诺,要求具体定理等等)。 由于这些政策的自相递减性质,这不仅会影响学生在未来推出"等待"或"回答:"等特定符号的可能性,还会改变整体推出分布,通过延长推理追踪,曝光出新的推理子导出,不同错误等. 在良性的情况下,这种在线动态可能是有益的,因为教师可以实时纠正学生,就像在“教程”课程中一样。

blocks.en: However, one can also imagine that such a dynamical process can be quite fragile for a ill-prepared student. A weak student’s tangent map Φ \Phi simply might not be very sensitive to the requests, resulting in limited motion propagated from training to future prefixes via kernel K K , thus limited changes in task accuracy. Moreover, even if there is substantial motion, such motion can be harmful. Taking our analogy further, an ill-prepared student which has not “gone to class before the tutorial” might benefit very little from online corrections on its own rollouts and even become more confused. That is, the ill-prepared student which has not been pretrained properly on the task and sustain sufficiently strong rollouts might only mimic superficial local patterns requested by the teacher, and push its rollout population μ \mu towards chaos , which can then be hard for the teacher to generate the right request population Γ \Gamma to even rescue, let alone improve.
blocks.zh: 然而,人们也可以想象这样一个动态过程对于准备不足的学生来说可能相当脆弱. 弱小学生的正切地图 \\ Phi 可能不会对请求非常敏感, 导致有限的运动通过内核 K K 传播到未来的前缀, 从而限制了任务准确性的变化 。 此外,即使有实质性动议,这种动议也可能是有害的。 更进一步地说,一个没有“在上课前上过课”的准备不足的学生可能很少能从自己推出的在线校正中受益,甚至更加困惑。 也就是说,没有经过适当训练的准备不足的学生, 并维持足够强大的推广, 可能只是模仿老师要求的肤浅的局部模式,

blocks.en: The rest of our analysis builds on the OPD loop and the response law to make precise the above intuitions, complemented by empirical analysis of real OPD runs, and examine how offline-distillation preparation before OPD helps alleviate the problems for weak student models. Section 3.2 (conversion) studies the student’s response to the supervised requests, which primarily concerns whether and how well a student model can convert different request populations Γ \Gamma (from different teachers) into policy motion z ˙ \dot{z} along the request fields. We develop early-training diagnostics of OPD runs from this perspective. Section 3.3 (broadcast) then focuses on where policy motion z ˙ \dot{z} goes and how it influences future training sources μ \mu , and analyze how and why policy motion which improves local per-prefix readouts (such as training loss) might not make positive progress on terminal readouts such as answer accuracy. Motivated by the failure mechanisms, we then show in Section 3.4 , across Qwen-2.5 and Llama-3.1 models, that with sufficient offline preparation, OPD runs improve pooled held-out accuracy (up to pass@32) and aggregate per-problem reliability on AIME 2024 and 2025 problems.
blocks.zh: 我们的其余分析以OPD环路和响应法为基础,精确地进行上述直觉,并辅之以对OPD实际运行的经验性分析,并研究OPD之前的离线分解准备如何帮助缓解弱学生模型的问题. 第3.2节(转换)研究了学生对受监督的请求的反应,其中主要涉及学生模式是否能够将不同的要求人口(来自不同的教师)转化为z\dot{z}在要求字段上的政策运动,以及该模式在多大程度上能够转化为不同的要求人口。 我们从这个角度出发,对发展办公室进行早期培训诊断。 第3.3节(广播)接着着重说明z\dot{z}的政策动议到哪里去以及它如何影响未来的培训来源 μ\ mu,并分析如何和为什么改进当地人均读取量(如培训损失)的政策动议在答复准确性等终端读取量方面可能没有取得积极进展。 在故障机制的推动下,我们在第3.4节中显示,通过充分的离线准备,OPD运行提高了集合被扣的准确性(上至通过@32),并在AIME 2024和2025年问题上提高了每个问题的总可靠性。

blocks.en: In the rest of this section, we primarily rely on the continuous gradient flow for cleaner theoretical discussions. Please see Section C.2 for further details on the finite step approximations.
blocks.zh: 在本节其余部分,我们主要依靠持续的梯度流进行更清洁的理论讨论。 请参看C.2节关于有限步骤近似的进一步详情。

blocks.en: 3.2 Conversion: Teacher requests and the student’s responsiveness
blocks.zh: 3.2 转换:教师的要求和学生的反应

blocks.en: Figure 2: Initial/end AIME accuracy; diamonds mark teachers. Red: sibling-taught; blue: larger-teacher taught.
blocks.zh: 图2:初步/最终AIME精度;钻石标记教师。 红色:师兄相接;蓝色:师大.

blocks.en: A strong teacher can transfer little. We open with an intriguing empirical puzzle identified in the OPD community ( Li et al., 2026b ) : a larger (same-family) teacher can transfer less than an RL-trained sibling even when they are nearly matched in bechmark performance, and Li et al. (2026b) suggests cancellation among token-level gradient signals as a possible explanation. We revisit this comparison at 1.5B and 7B ( Figure 2 ), holding the starting DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen student and OPD recipe fixed within each scale. JustRL-1.5B and AceReason-Nemotron-7B yield substantial gains, whereas the larger DeepSeek-7B and DeepSeek-14B teachers transfer little throughout training despite higher benchmark scores ( Section D.1 ). We call these runs healthy and stalled . We find that the teachers’ request fields differ substantially in semantic functions, and that the student’s responsiveness to these requests separates in two axes: coherence of the gradient signals, and kernel adaptation toward the requests. Along the way, we develop early-training diagnostics that help reveal the “request-conversion” health of a training run.
blocks.zh: 强师能转少. 我们以一个在OPD社区(Li等人,2026年b)中发现的有趣经验谜题开场:一个较大的(同族)教师即使几乎与贝克马克的性能相匹配,也可以转会少于RL训练的弟弟;而Li等人(2026年b)建议在象征级梯度信号中取消作为可能的解释. 我们以1.5B和7B(图2)重新审视这一比较,将开始的DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Quen学生和OPD配方固定在每个尺度内。 JustRL-1.5B和AceReason-Nemotron-7B取得了很大收益,而较大的DeepSeek-7B和DeepSeek-14B教师在整个培训过程中几乎没有调动,尽管基准分数较高(D.1节)。 我们称之为健康运行和停滞。 我们发现,教师的要求领域在语义功能上有很大的不同,学生对这些要求的反应分出两个轴心:梯度信号的一致性和内核适应要求。 沿途,我们发展早期培训诊断,帮助揭示培训的“要求转化”健康。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Teacher request fields differ systematically. The RL-sibling teachers’ increasingly emphasize requests on sentence openings and “control-oriented” moves, while the larger teachers’ stay in sentence interiors and “technical-oriented” content. In (b) we show finer semantic categories of the request fields. blocks.en: As we see in the OPD update loop in Section 3.1 , the teacher’s request population Γ t \Gamma_{t} at time 0 “kickstart” the whole learning process, from which the shared-parameter student model propagates into policy motion via its kernel K t K_{t} . Since the student starts out to be the same while the teachers are different across the healthy and stalled runs, their request fields become the natural entry point for our analysis.
blocks.zh: 正如我们从第3.1节的OPD更新循环中看到的那样,教师们要求的人口在0"开始"整个学习过程,从这个过程中,共享参数的学生模式通过其内核K t K_{t}传播到政策运动. 由于学生开始是相同的,而教师们在健康而停滞的跑道上是不同的,所以他们的要求领域成了我们分析的自然切入点.

blocks.en: On fixed initial-student rollouts, Figure 3 compares where each teacher’s largest-normed requests occur. (a) shows the coarse tendencies of the semantics of the requests as we move up the request-norm percentile, while (b) and (c) show the finer semantic categories and contrast the teachers’ distinct request fields. We find that the RL-sibling teachers increasingly emphasize reasoning-management and initiating positions, while the larger teachers place relatively more of their strongest requests at technically oriented (e.g. digit-bearing, recalling mathematical fact) positions. This separation connects to findings in the reasoning-interpretability community, that RL tends to improve how well the model “orchestrates” the base reasoning mechanisms (including epistemic control abilities) ( Venhoff et al., 2025a ) . Full setup and analysis results are in Section D.2 .
blocks.zh: 在固定的初始学生推出, 图3比较了每个教师最大的语言要求。 (a) 当我们向上移动时,这些要求的语义有粗糙的倾向,而(b) 和(c) 显示更精细的语义类别,并比较教师的不同请求字段。 我们发现,RL姊妹教师越来越强调推理管理和启动职位,而较大的教师则比较多地将其最强烈的要求放在技术方向(例如,数字化,回顾数学事实)职位上。 这种分离联系到推理-可解释性社群中的结论,即RL倾向于改进模型"组织"的基本推理机制(包括癫痫控制能力)(Venhoff等,2025a.)的完善程度. 完整的设置和分析结果载于D.2节。

blocks.en: These results distinguish healthy and stalled pairings early on in an OPD training run in the requests they receive and the responsiveness their tangent geometry develop, giving diagnostics beyond the standard gradient norm and training loss from the request-conversion aspect. The next sub-section will study what comes next: when there is significant policy motion, cumulated over time, where do they head to? Why do two student models OPD-trained under the same teacher, both reducing training loss substantially, have different generalization performance under OPD?
blocks.zh: 这些结果区分了早期在对所收到请求进行的OPD培训中健康而停滞的配对,以及其正切几何的响应性发展,给出了超出标准梯度规范的诊断,以及请求转换方面的培训损失. 下个分节将研究接下来的情况:当出现重大的政策动议时,这些动议会逐渐累积起来,它们将走向何处? 为什么在同一个教师领导下培训的两种学生模式在大幅度减少培训损失的同时,在OPD之下有不同的概括表现?

blocks.en: Intuitively, significant prefix-visitation change can be either beneficial or damaging. For a weak student, it can route into low-quality, chaotic rollout distributions on which the teacher struggle to give requests that can help recover (or raise) the student’s intermediate reasoning performance and terminal scores. On the flip side, the continually refreshed training rollouts also allow the possibility of “online corrections”, where problematic reasoning behaviors broadcasted from early training can be corrected by the teacher mid-training. We will see these effects in our empirical analysis later.
blocks.zh: 直观地说,重大的前缀访问变化可能有利或有害. 对于一个弱小的学生来说,它可以引导到质量低、混乱的推广分布,而教师在这种分布上挣扎着提出能够帮助恢复(或提高)学生的中间推理表现和终极分数的请求。 在另一方面,不断更新的培训推出也允许进行“在线矫正”,通过早期培训传播的有问题的推理行为可由教师中期培训纠正。 我们稍后将在经验分析中看到这些影响。

blocks.en:
In the early phase of training, the teacher pushes the weak learner toward longer rollouts (such as heavy negative requests on the student’s “overly early” answer commitments), but these extensions become high-entropy and incoherent. The teacher supervision there also becomes much less concentrated than in the shallower rollout windows ( Figure 5 c,d). As seen in Figure 5 (a) and (b), from step 1 to 20, loss rises 0.58 → 0.85 0.58\to 0.85 (routing + 0.455 +0.455 outweighs drift − 0.187 -0.187 ); entropy also rises mainly through routing. Intuitively, the student, which has never been trained to emit long reasoning rollouts, gets pushed into reasoning for long before committing an answer, and executing reasoning states which it is highly unfamiliar with. The teacher, conditioned on these low-quality states, also give much less confident guidance.
The drift of the loss is small in this phase, however: the student has not learned the flatter prediction patterns of the teacher (uniformly) across the visited prefixes yet.
blocks.zh:
在培训的早期阶段,教师将弱小的学习者推向更长时间的推广(例如对学生的“超早期”回答承诺的强烈负面要求),但这些扩展却变得高调和不连贯。 那里的教师监管也比更浅的推出窗口集中得多(图5 c,d)。 如图5(a)和(b)所示,从第1步起至第20步,损失增加0.58 — 0.85 0.58\至0.85(路线+0.455+0.455大于漂移−0.187-0.187); en也主要通过路线上升. 直觉上,这个从未受过训练的学生在做出回答之前,就被推入推理圈,而执行推理则说明自己非常不熟悉。 以这些低质状态为条件的老师也给予信心更低的指引.
然而,这一阶段损失的漂移幅度很小:学生还没有在访问的前缀上(统一地)学会老师的自夸预测模式.

blocks.en:
What happens after the initial routing-dominated phase is dominated by drift (local fitting) on the unreliable request distributions.
As seen in Figure 5 , entropy remains high within the band around 2 − 4 2-4 nats, and loss reduction is increasingly driven by drift, that is, the student is indeed fitting the teacher’s low confidence predictions on the chaotic, low-quality prefixes continually generated during training. To further test this, we find that, on the same batch-41 training prefixes, loss falls 0.79 → 0.06 0.79\to 0.06 while entropy falls 4.99 → 3.99 4.99\to 3.99 : drift over the course of training actually broadcasts and sharpens predictions on this rollout bank toward an uncertain but slightly less entropic teacher ( Sections C.9 and E.3.1 ).

最初以路由为主的相后发生的事情,主要是在不可靠的请求分配上漂移(局部相接).
如图5所显示的,Entropy在大约2 - 4 2 -4纳特的波段内仍然很高,减少损失越来越受漂移的驱使,也就是说,该学生确实在适应教师对培训期间不断产生的混乱而低质量的前缀的低信心预测。 为了进一步检验这一点,我们发现,在同一批41次训练前缀上,损失下降为0.79 ~ 0.06 0.79 至 0.06,而Entropy则下降为4.99 → 3.99 4.99 至 3.99 :实际在训练课程中进行广播,使这一推广库的预测更加精确,向一名不确定但稍少的Entroptic教师倾斜(C.9和E.3.1节)。

blocks.en: So far we see that the weak Qwen model’s failed run has the OPD update loop spending later, more “stable” drift-dominated updates learning from unreliable requests on the low-quality generative distribution. This helps us better understand how the training loss declines. Intuitively, fitting unreliable teacher supervision on high-entropy rollouts already suggests that this will not yield a better-reasoning student model. To understand how and why this process worsens terminal score more precisely, we need to turn to Equation 9 : policy motion influences non-local readouts (including terminal score) through the value / advantage of the student’s continuations (namely the Q − V Q-V advantage summed across the prefixes), which can be in conflict with local teacher agreement.
blocks.zh: 到目前为止,我们看到,弱小的Quen模型的运行失败了,后来的OPD更新循环支出,更“平稳”的漂移为主的更新,从关于低质量基因分配的不可靠的请求中学习。 这有助于我们更好地了解培训损失如何减少。 从直觉上来说,在高水平的推广中配上不可靠的教师监督已经表明,这不会产生更合理的学生模式。 为了更确切地理解这个过程如何和为什么使终端分数恶化,我们需要转向第9个方程式:政策运动通过学生续作的价值/优势(即横跨前缀的Q-V-V优势)影响非本地读取(包括终端分数),这可能会与当地教师协议相冲突.

blocks.en: While it is prohibitively expensive to directly compute the “velocity × \times advantage” term in Equation 9 , we find on select banks of probing rollouts and continuations that as training proceeds, the model increasingly make local decisions whose continuation correctness decline, and complementarily, visit prefixes that are difficult to reach the right answer at increasingly shallower depth. This tells us that the per-token policy velocity of the model tend to align with “negative advantage” over the course of training, resulting in the overall decline of terminal accuracy. We elaborate on these studies below.
blocks.zh: 虽然直接计算第9个方程式中的“速度×\时间优势”一词费用高昂,但我们发现,随着培训的进行,该模式越来越多地作出地方决定,其持续正确性下降,并补充了在越来越浅的深度难以找到正确答案的前缀。 这告诉我们,在培训过程中,模型的每个政策速度往往与“负面优势”相一致,导致终端准确性全面下降。 下文详述这些研究。

blocks.en: First, to probe the continuation-value term in Equation 9 , we freeze a set of answer-decision prefixes from the initial student’s held-out MATH rollouts and intervene on the local “answer-versus-continue” decision token position. The student’s probability of the answer branch falls from 0.74 → 0.19 → 0.07 0.74\to 0.19\to 0.07 at steps 0, 20, 100, below the teacher’s 0.30 0.30 on the same prefixes. At update 20, while “routing” is dominating, counterfactual continuations from the two branches have similar downstream value (correct 0.30 0.30 for the “answer” branch and 0.29 0.29 for the “continue” branch), i.e. the student still maintains reasonable answer-reaching abilities. By update 100, however, the continue-branch rarely produces the answer ( 8 % 8\% of continuations). The teacher’s own continuations from the same prefixes is correct 0.60 0.60 of the time, which is much higher, so the gap is in the student’s degraded execution of the action branch, not in the branch itself. For a complete treatment of how we decompose and estimate Equation 9 see Section E.4 .
blocks.zh: 首先,为了探究第9个方程式中的续作价值,我们冻结了最初学生被搁置的MATH推出的一组解答前缀,并介入当地“答对续作”决定符号位置。 学生在回答分会的概率从0.74~0.19~0.07 0.74~0.19~0.07在0,20,100步,低于老师在同一前缀上0.300.30分. 在更新20中,虽然“路径”占主导地位,但两个分支的反事实延续具有类似的下游价值(“回答”分支更正为0.30 0.30,“继续”分支更正为0.29 0.29),即学生仍然保持合理的回答能力。 然而,通过更新100,继续分行很少产生答案(8%的续作). 老师自己从同名前缀接续的时间是正确的0.60. 0.60,这要高得多,所以差距在于学生退化地执行动作分会,而不是分会本身. 关于我们如何分解和估计方程式9的完整处理,见E.4节。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Initial-policy continuation success rate on trained prefixes. Negative values indicate harder prefixes for reaching the right answer.
blocks.zh: 图6:经过培训的前缀的初始政策继续成功率。 负值表示达到正确答案的更硬前缀.

blocks.en: Now, these probes fix the prefixes and probe how the student checkpoints continues them. As we discussed before, the broadcast mechanism changes both prefix visitation and continuations from them, therefore we next ask the complementary question of whether the prefixes visited during OPD also become increasingly harder to complete . We fix a few rollout depths and student checkpoints, sample prefixes generated from these checkpoints at those depths, and then let the initial student (as a reference policy) to finish. Keeping the continuer fixed makes changes in success reflect changes in prefix visitation. To understand the principled connections between these reference-continuer effects and Equation 9 , please refer to Section E.7 . Empirically, Figure 6 shows a clear increase in continuation difficulty due to the prefix visitation shift, on the axes of rollout depths and training length. At step 50, while the shallow prefixes remains usable (even slightly better than the initial policy’s own prefixes), it already yields less successful continuations on deep prefixes. As training goes on, the decline show up at increasingly shallower cuts of the rollout.
blocks.zh: 现在,这些探测器固定了前缀,并探测学生检查站如何继续它们. 正如我们之前讨论的那样,广播机制既改变了前缀访问,也改变了续作,因此,我们接下来问一个补充问题,即OPD期间访问的前缀是否也越来越难完成。 我们固定了几个推出的深度和学生检查站,在这些深度这些检查站生成的样本前缀,然后让初始学生(作为参考政策)完成. 保持接续器的固定使成功率的变化反映了前缀访问量的变化. 为了解这些参考连续效应与第9等同的原则联系,请参见E.7节。 图6从经验上显示,由于前缀出访移位,出行深度与训练长度等轴上,接续难度明显增加. 在第50步,虽然浅色前缀仍然可以使用(甚至略好于最初政策本身的前缀),但是在深色前缀上它已经产生不太成功的续作. 随着培训的进行,推出的削减越来越浅。

blocks.en: Figure 7: Conditional checking refinement. Filled circles: initial over-use; open triangles: initial under-use.
blocks.zh: 图7:有条件检查改进。 填充圆:初始过度使用;开放三角:初始使用不足.

blocks.en: DeepSeek supplies the clean contrast. Loss falls 0.263 → 0.015 0.263\to 0.015 , mainly through drift ( − 0.214 -0.214 ) rather than routing ( − 0.033 -0.033 ), indicating more more stable prefix visitations and local learning of requests. Furthermore, motivated by the epistemic-control request distribution found in Section 3.2 , we design a local readout to examine the dynamics of how the model acquires intermediate reasoning behaviors, focusing on “wait”-family initiation at sentence starts (observed to initiate important backtracking and checking behaviors in R1-styled models ( Marjanovic et al., 2026 ) ). On each prefix, let w t w_{t} and q W q_{W} denote student and teacher WAIT-family probabilities. We freeze two classes: over-use ( w 0 > q W w_{0}>q_{W} ) and under-use ( w 0 < q W w_{0}<q_{W} ), and set the local readout to be log ⁡ [ w t / ( 1 − w t ) ] \log[w_{t}/(1-w_{t})] (log-odds of “wait” initiation).
blocks.zh: DeepSeek提供干净的对比。 损失为0.263~0.015 0.263\至0.015,主要通过漂流(−0.214-0.214)而不是去向(−0.033-0.033),表明更稳定的前缀访问和当地学习请求. 此外,出于第3.2节中发现的感知控制请求分布的动机,我们设计了一个局部读出,以审查模型如何获得中间推理行为的动态,重点是在句子开始时“等待”-家庭启动(可观察在R1类型模型中启动重要的回溯跟踪和检查行为(Marjanovic等,2026年))。 在每一个前缀上,让wt w_{t}和q W q_{w}表示学生和教师的等待-家庭概率。 我们冻结两个类别:过度使用(w 0 > q) W w0}>q_{q_{W})和使用不足(w 0 < q W_{0}<q_{W}),并设定本地读出为log⁡ [w t  (1−-w wt})] (log-odds of "等"启动).

blocks.en: Figure 7 plots cumulative routing and drift of the “wait”-readout. Filled circles move downward: drift suppresses initial over-use. Open triangles move upward: drift promotes initial under-use. The corresponding net changes are − 1.82 -1.82 and + 1.92 +1.92 nats. While there are short overshoots of routing-dominated changes (early false suppression of under-use positions and promotion of over-use positions), they are quickly stabilized. Moreover, teacher-relative disagreement also decreases on frozen and held-out rollout banks ( Section E.2 ). Thus, unlike the failed learner’s case where drift-dominated reduction of training loss happened on unreliable prefixes, DeepSeek’s stabler drift-dominated reduction on training loss not only improves on its terminal score, but is accompanied by improvements in intermediate reasoning behaviors, with it sustaining prefix populations that allows to learn when to initiate a “wait”-based check as a representative example.
blocks.zh: 图7 “等待”读取的累计路线和漂移情况。 填充圆向下移动:漂移抑制了初始过度使用. 开放三角向上移动:漂移能促进初始使用不足. 相应的净变化为−1.82-1.82和+1.92+1.92纳特. 虽然路由为主的变化(早期错误地压制了使用不足的职位并提升了使用过度的职位)存在短暂的过量,但很快稳定了下来. 此外,教师与亲属之间的分歧也减少了冻结和搁置的推出银行(E.2节)。 因此,与失败的学习者的情况不同,在不可靠的前缀上出现了以漂移为主的减少培训损失的情况,DeepSeek以更稳定地漂移为主的减少培训损失不仅改善了其末端分数,而且伴随着中间推理行为的改进,它维持了前缀人群,从而可以学习何时启动“等待”的检查作为有代表性的例子。

blocks.en: The base Qwen model, prepared with offline distillation training on teacher rollouts, also undergoes substantial prefix visitation shifts, but sustains useful learning. Unlike DeepSeek’s smoother refinement, its loss and checking behavior are nonmonotone: a routing-dominated overshoot in loss and reasoning (epistemic) behaviors are followed by lower-entropy rollouts and conditional moderation of reasoning behaviors dominated by drift. Its held-out gains suggest that a stronger starting policy with higher prefix quality and continuation-readiness makes these excursions amenable to correction. Full analysis in Section E.5 .
blocks.zh: 基础Quen模型是用关于教师推广的离线分解训练来制备的,它也经历了大量的前缀访问分班,但保持了有益的学习. 与DeepSeek的更平稳的完善不同,其损失和检查行为是非模棱两可的:在损失和推理(流行病)行为中以路线为主的过度射出,然后是低调地展开和有条件地温和以漂移为主的推理行为。 它的搁置成果表明,如果采取更强有力的起步政策,提高前缀质量和持续准备状态,这些出行便可以改正。 E.5节的全面分析。

blocks.en: 3.4 Preparation: improving the starting point of on-policy learning
blocks.zh: 3.4 筹备:改进政策学习的起点

blocks.en: Figure 8: Offline-prepared OPD improves sampled coverage and reliability. Left: pooled AIME 2024/2025 pass@ k k for k ≤ 32 k\leq 32 (top) and the fraction of problems with empirical solve rate ≥ r > 0 \geq r>0 (bottom), using 32 responses per problem from batch a. Right: preparation dose versus strict MATH-500 pass@1, using the step-100 OPD checkpoint at 1.5B and the best evaluated checkpoint within 100 steps at 7B; error bars are 95% problem-bootstrap intervals. See Sections F.1 and F.2 for protocols and paired comparisons.
blocks.zh: 图8:离线准备的OPD改进了抽样覆盖范围和可靠性. 左:集合 AIME 2024/2025 pass@ kk for k → 32 k\leq 32 (top) 和经验解析率的一小部分问题 → r > 0\ geq r>0 (从下到下),使用从 a 批中每个问题的32个响应. 右:准备剂量与严格的MATH-500通过@1,使用1.5B的步-100 OPD检查点和7B的100步内最佳评估检查点;出错栏为95%的问题-陷阱间隔. 协议和对等比较见F.1和F.2节。

blocks.en: Section 3.3 suggests a direct intervention. As we saw in the last sub-section, OPD can fail because early policy changes route the weak student model into reasoning states it cannot yet execute reliably, and the training run spends a large chunk of time fitting unreliable requests on increasingly lower-quality prefixes. Then, a natural candidate intervention is that, before OPD, we force the student to visit higher-quality prefixes from the teacher itself and learn the teacher’s stronger continuations on those prefix populations. This suggests offline distillation to prepare the student model’s continuation abilities before running OPD, which can then expose finer student errors to the teacher and sustain more stable learning trajectory for online corrections when OPD changes prefix visitation, without the requests looking so foreign to the student in the OPD phase that it routes into irrecoverable rollout distributions.
blocks.zh: 第3.3节建议直接干预。 正如我们在最后一分节所看到的那样,OPD可能失败,因为早期的政策改变将弱小的学生模式引导到推理中,说明它还不能可靠地执行,而训练运行花费了很长的时间来适应越来越低质量的前缀上的不可靠的请求. 因此,一个自然的候选者干预是,在OPD之前,我们强迫学生从老师身上访问更高质量的前缀并学习老师在这些前缀人群上的更强续作. 这表明离线蒸馏在运行 OPD 之前为学生模型的继续能力做准备,然后可以向老师揭露更细微的学生出错,并在 OPD 更改前缀访问时维持更稳定的学习轨迹进行在线校正,而不会让在 OPD 阶段的学生看起来如此陌生,从而引导到无法恢复的推广分发.

blocks.en: We prepare with student/teacher pairings Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct/JustRL-1.5B ( Qwen et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2025 ) , Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct/AceReason-Nemotron-7B ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct/Llama-3.1-Nemotron-Nano-8B-v1 ( Llama Team, 2024 ; Bercovich et al., 2025 ) , with students trained on their teachers’ solutions to OpenMathInstruct-2 ( Toshniwal et al., 2024 ) . We then compare OPD with continued offline distillation on the same DAPO-Math-17k prompt blocks ( Yu et al., 2025 ) , matching optimizer steps and sequence presentations.
blocks.zh: 我们准备与学生/老师配对 文2.5-1.5B-指示/JustRL-1.5B (Quen等,2025;He等,2025.),Quen2.5-7B-Instruct/AceReason-Nemotron-7B. (Chen等,2025),和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct/Llama-3.1-Nemotron-Nano-8B-v1(Llama Team,2024;Bercovich等,2025),对学生进行教师解决OpenMathInstruct-2(Toshniwal等,2024)的培训. 然后,我们将OPD与同一DAPO-Math-17k快取区块(Yu等,2025年)上的持续离线蒸馏进行比较,匹配优化步骤和序列演示.

blocks.en: Figure 8 shows higher pooled pass@ k k accuracy for OPD than offline training through k = 32 k=32 , using 32 responses per problem. The gains extend beyond pass@1 to sampled coverage and the distribution of per-problem solve rates. The reliability improvement is especially interesting: looking at pass@ k k alone might give us the impression that OPD just solves more problems by rare chances, however, we find that OPD with appropriate preparation also enhances the per-problem solve rates for the models beyond the offline-distillation-only alternatives. Additionally, the preparation “dose study” ( Figure 8 , right) shows increasing value of offline-preparation for the later OPD phase. At 1.5B, one to four passes leaves the starting strict MATH pass@1 at 45.7 45.7 – 47.1 % 47.1\% , but raises the 100-step OPD endpoint from 45.9 % 45.9\% to 56.2 % 56.2\% . Similar trends are observed at 7B ( Section F.2 ). Please refer to Section F.1 for further details.
blocks.zh: 图8通过k=32k=32的离线训练,利用每个问题的32个答复,显示OPD的集合通关@kk精度高于离线训练. 收益范围从通过@1扩大到抽样覆盖面和每个问题解决率的分配。 可靠性的提高特别有趣:光看通过@kk可能给我们留下这样的印象,即OPD只是通过难得的机会解决了更多的问题,然而,我们发现,经过适当准备的OPD也会提高除离线-除尘器外的模型的每个问题的解决率。 此外,编制“剂量研究”(图8,右)显示,为以后的OPD阶段进行线下准备的价值正在增加。 在1.5B时,1到4个通行证离开严格的MATH通行证@1,45.7 45.7 – 47.1% 47.1\%,但将100步OPD终点从45.9% 45.9\%提高到56.2% 56.2\%. 7B也有类似趋势(F.2节)。 详见F.1节。

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en:
Findings. We studied on-policy distillation as a feedback loop between teacher supervision, student response, and the rollout distribution that supplies future supervision.
Our analysis separates two mechanisms in this loop: conversion , and broadcast . Across our settings, these mechanisms explain both stalled transfer and deterioration despite improving local teacher agreement. Offline preparation changes the starting point of this loop: even with little immediate accuracy improvement, it can enable
substantial gains from subsequent OPD.
blocks.zh:
发现 我们研究了政策提炼,作为教师监督、学生反应和提供未来监督的推广分发之间的反馈循环。
我们的分析在这个循环中分离出两个机制:转换和广播。 尽管当地教师协议有所改善,但这些机制在我们的整个环境中都解释了转移受阻和恶化的原因。 离线准备会改变这个循环的起点:即使没有立即改进准确性,它也能启用
从随后的海外办事处获得大量收益。

blocks.en: Limitations and discussion. Our empirical analysis is confined to mathematical reasoning and a select set of LLM models due to resource limitations. We also present a more detailed Q&A in Appendix A to further clarify potential ambiguities in our work.
blocks.zh: 限制和讨论。 我们的经验分析仅限于数学推理和一组因资源限制而选择的LLM模型. 我们还在附录A中提出了更详细的`A',以进一步澄清我们工作中可能存在的模糊之处。

blocks.en: Appendix A Mechanistic interpretation and key questions
blocks.zh: 机械解释和关键问题

blocks.en: Q1. What do the response law and decompositions in Sections 3.1 , 3.2 and 3.3 explain beyond their familiar mathematical ingredients?
blocks.zh: 问题1. 第3.1、3.2和3.3节中的反应定律和分解在其熟悉的数学成份之外有什么解释?

blocks.en: They provide a connected mechanistic account of how dense local supervision can produce either weak transfer or deteriorating generation. OPD updates the policy that generates its next training population. Understanding its dynamics therefore requires following supervision beyond the current loss, through its effects on future behavior and training histories (student’s rollouts and the induced supervision signals / request field).
blocks.zh: 它们提供了连通的机械说明,说明地方监督的密集程度可产生薄弱的转移或退化的一代。 发展办公室更新了产生下一个培训人口的政策。 因此,了解其动态需要跟踪当前损失以外的监督,通过其对未来行为和培训历史的影响(学生的推出和诱导的监督信号/请求字段)。

blocks.en: The theory separates three links in this process. First, Section 3.2 explains how a teacher’s requests become parameter motion: accessibility determines their expression through the student’s tangent map, while coherence determines how the resulting gradients combine. Teacher benchmark performance, magnitude of (KL-based) disagreement, or gradient norm alone cannot characterize this conversion. Second, Section 3.3 distinguishes changing a prediction from changing the ancestral decisions that make its history likely. Shared-parameter broadcast can increase exposure to a continuation without making the student better at executing it; the resulting histories then change the supervision received from the same fixed teacher. Third, Equation 9 connects the delivered response to completed outcomes through what the student’s remaining policy can achieve, separating teacher matching from useful reasoning.
blocks.zh: 该理论在这个过程中分离出三个环节. 首先,第3.2节解释了教师的要求如何成为参数运动:无障碍通过学生的切入图来决定他们的表达,而一致性则决定由此产生的梯度如何结合. 教师基准性能、(基于KL的)分歧程度或梯度规范不能成为这种转换的特征。 第二,第3.3节区分了改变预测和改变使其历史可能发生的祖先决定。 共用参数广播可以增加续作的曝光率,而不会让学生更好地执行;随后产生的历史会改变从同一固定教师那里得到的监督。 第三,方程式9通过学生余下政策所能达到的目标,将所给出的响应与完成的结果联系起来,将教师匹配与有用的推理区分开来.

blocks.en: Together, these links explain the structure of the empirical puzzles. The stronger-teacher study exposes the importance of gradient coherence and tangent accessibility; the degenerate run exposes that, under substantial policy motion, the degree of freedom granted to the learner to generate its own rollouts (training histories) can make it generate the new rollouts (reasoning states) which it has difficulty managing and grows uncertain on, inducing poorer-quality supervision signals. Loss reduction dominated by local fitting on these poorly supervised rollouts cannot improve the learner’s terminal scores. The mechanisms revealed in the degenerate run motivates preparing the student for the continuations that OPD will elicit, even when preparation does not substantially improve current accuracy by itself. The theoretical contribution is the integrated explanation that makes these mechanisms distinguishable, connects them to outcomes, and motivates an intervention that boosts the model’s learning stability and generalization.
blocks.zh: 这些链接共同解释了经验谜题的结构. 更强的教师研究揭示了梯度一致性和即时可获性的重要性;堕落的跑道暴露出,在实质性的政策动议下,给予学习者产生自己的推广(培训历史)的自由程度可以使它产生新的推广(理性状态),它难以管理和增加不确定性,诱发质量更差的监督信号. 减低损失主要在于当地安装这些监督不力的推出,这并不能改善学习者的终端分数。 退化跑道中揭示出的机制促使学生做好继续学习的准备,即使准备本身并没有大幅度地提高目前的准确性。 理论贡献是综合解释,使这些机制可以区分,将它们与结果联系起来,并激励一种干预,促进模型的学习稳定性和通俗化.

blocks.en: Q2. Why is every training run reported with a single seed?
blocks.zh: 问题2. 为何每一次培训都报告有单一种子?

blocks.en: Cost . The runs behind this paper were trained and evaluated on GH200 nodes, and the single-seed set already consumed roughly 4,000 GPU-hours, which is at the limit of our computing resources. OPD is known to be computationally demanding, we therefore designed the experiments so that the main comparisons do not rest on seed variance. The mechanism measurements of Sections 3.2 and 3.3 are exact identities evaluated within a run, on fixed receiver banks and fixed checkpoints, and their uncertainty is reported at the level of problems or sites (paired bootstrap intervals). The outcome comparisons of Section 3.4 are paired within a student-teacher pair on the same problems and replicated across three pairs and two student scales. What single seeds leave unquantified is run-to-run variation of the training trajectories themselves.
blocks.zh: 成本 . 这篇论文背后的跑道在GH200节点上经过了培训和评估,而单种子集已经消耗了大约4000个GPU小时,这已经是我们的计算资源的极限了. 众所周知,OPD在计算上要求很高,因此我们设计了实验,以便主要比较不依赖于种子差异. 第3.2和3.3节的机制测量是在固定接收银行和固定检查站的运行中评估的确切身份,其不确定性在问题或地点一级报告(靴子间隔)。 第3.4节的结果比较是在同一问题上的学生-教师对一对,并在三个对一和两个学生规模之间复制。 单一种子留下的未量化的,是训练轨迹本身的跑到跑的变化.

blocks.en: Q3. Why does Section 3.3 need both prefix-level routing/drift ( Equation 5 ) and trajectory-level continuation advantages ( Equation 9 ) to explain degeneration?
blocks.zh: 问题3. 第3.3节为什么既需要前缀级的路由/干道(第5个方程式),又需要轨迹级的延续优势(第9个方程式)来解释衰变?

blocks.en: For loss or entropy, J Y = 𝔼 ν t ​ Y t ​ ( x ) J_{Y}=\mathbb{E}_{\nu_{t}}Y_{t}(x) describes predictions on the currently observed histories. Cross-scoring separates changes in those histories from changes in predictions on the same histories. In Figure 5 , the initial student is already highly uncertain on the deep histories that later become prevalent, while subsequent fitting sharpens them. On identical batch-41 histories, discrepancy falls 0.79 → 0.06 0.79\to 0.06 and entropy 4.99 → 3.99 4.99\to 3.99 . Together with the stopping/reach probes, these measurements distinguish routing followed by fitting from uniform entropy-increasing drift ( Sections E.3 and E.3.1 ).

blocks.en: But fitting a prefix and improving the completion from it are different effects. For terminal correctness, J Y = 𝔼 Π t ​ Y J_{Y}=\mathbb{E}_{\Pi_{t}}Y , and the conditional value V t Y ​ ( x ) V_{t}^{Y}(x) depends on every downstream decision . At an intermediate cut of the autoregressive trace, its derivative separates changes in reaching the cut from changes in the remaining policy. Unrolling the latter gives the continuation-advantage weighting in Equation 9 ; replacing it with a derivative of the logits at x x alone would omit downstream effects ( Section C.8 ). Thus, a teacher-preferred next token need not help if the student cannot complete the reasoning it initiates. The prefix analysis establishes the observed routing-then-fitting pattern; the outcome analysis explains why local fitting need not restore correctness. Entropy enters the argument only as a prefix-level readout.

Entropy 仅作为前缀级读出输入参数.

blocks.en: Q4. Could the responsiveness changes in Section 3.2 (Figure 4 ) simply reflect changing teacher–student disagreement or generic kernel movement?
blocks.zh: 问题4. 第3.2节(图4)的响应性变化能否仅仅反映教师-学生分歧或一般内核运动的变化?

We therefore fix the initial numerical requests B 0 B_{0} , exact histories, and output coordinates across checkpoints. Since only the kernel varies in A t ​ [ B 0 ] A_{t}[B_{0}] , its change measures responsiveness to the same supervision ( Section C.4 ).

blocks.en: To test whether eigenspace movement reflects teacher-specific adaptation, we evaluate both teachers’ frozen fields in the same checkpoint kernel and compare their projection gains, separating preferential reorientation from shared movement that benefits both fields. Healthy 1.5B exhibits preferential reorientation; healthy 7B mainly amplifies existing directions; stalled runs lose sensitivity to the fixed requests ( Section D.5 ). These findings complement the initial accessibility/coherence decomposition, which exposes conversion differences concealed by comparable gradient norms across the runs.
blocks.zh: 为了测试Eigenspace运动是否反映了教师的适应性,我们评价了教师在同一检查点内核中的被冻结的田地,并比较了他们的预测收益,将优惠调整方向与有利于两个田地的共享运动区分开来. 健康1.5B显示优先调整方向;健康7B主要扩大现有方向;停滞运行会失去对固定请求的敏感性(D.5节)。 这些结论补充了最初的可获取性/一致性分解,它暴露出转换差异被各行可比梯度规范所掩盖.

blocks.en: Q5. What does preparation in Sections 3.4 and 8 contribute beyond offline warm-up, and how does Section 3.3 motivate it?
blocks.zh: 问题5. 第3.4和8节的准备工作对离线热身有何贡献? 第3.3节如何推动这项工作?

blocks.en: The contribution is an explanation of why the value of a warm-up stage, already used in prior work ( Appendix B ), should be assessed through subsequent learning . The failure mechanism identifies a mismatch between making extended reasoning likely and being able to execute it. Offline distillation supplies teacher-generated reasoning histories without requiring the initial student to generate them first. It can therefore prepare continuation skills and reasoning-state management that become useful as OPD changes visitation: continuation readiness , a benefit beyond higher starting accuracy – our pass@k results clearly demonstrate this.
blocks.zh: 这份来文解释了为何应通过随后的学习来评估在以前工作中已经使用的热身阶段的价值(附录B)。 故障机制识别出在使扩展推理成为可能与能够执行两者之间的不匹配. 离线蒸馏提供由教师创造的推理史,而不要求初学者先生成. 因此,它可以准备持续技能和推理状态管理,随着OPD改变访问方式而变得有用:持续准备,这种好处超越了更高的起始精度 — — 我们的通过@k结果清楚地表明了这一点。

blocks.en: Appendix B Expanded related work
blocks.zh: 附录B 扩大的相关工作

blocks.en: B.1 Core related works
blocks.zh: 第B.1节 核心相关工作

blocks.en: Distillation and the OPD loop. Knowledge distillation transfers teacher outputs ( Hinton et al., 2015 ) , including teacher-generated sequences ( Kim and Rush, 2016 ) . DAgger, the seminal online imitation algorithm, addresses distribution shift through expert feedback on learner-visited states ( Ross et al., 2011 ) ; Lin et al. (2020) develop this connection for autoregressive distillation. MiniLLM uses reverse KL and student-generated samples ( Gu et al., 2024 ) , ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Piskorz et al., 2026 ) study the choice of divergence loss, and Lu and Thinking Machines Lab (2025) demonstrate practical OPD for reasoning and personalization. These methods motivate our question: how does dense supervision on student histories produce successful transfer, stagnation, or degeneration? We develop a systematic first-principles account of the coupled loop through which shared-parameter updates change predictions, renew visited histories, and reshape subsequent supervision.
blocks.zh: 蒸发和OPD循环. 知识分馏转移教师产出(Hinton等人,2015年),包括教师产生的序列 (金和拉什,2016). DAgger,开创性的在线仿真算法,通过专家对学习者访问状态的反馈解决了分布转移(Ross等,2011年;Lin等. (2020)为自递蒸馏开发出这种连接. MiniLLM使用反向KL和学生生成的样本(Gu等,2024年),(Agarwal等,2024年;Piskorz等,2026年)研究差异损失的选择,而Lu和思维机器实验室(2025年)演示了推理和个人化实用的OPD. 这些方法引发了我们的问题:对学生历史的严密监督如何产生成功的转移、停滞或退化? 我们对共享参数更新变化预测、更新访问历史并重塑后续监督的连锁循环制定了系统的第一原则。

blocks.en: Kernel response laws. The neural tangent kernel connects parameter learning to function-space change ( Jacot et al., 2018 ) . Malladi et al. (2023) analyze language-model finetuning through kernels, including an Adam extension; Ren and Sutherland (2025) decompose prediction changes through normalization, empirical-kernel, and loss-gradient terms for SFT and preference finetuning, including offline DPO. Tomihari (2026) studies update propagation in RL post-training. OPD needs different theoretical and empirical machinery for two reasons. Its on-policy sampling moves the learning distribution itself, so the analysis must track this motion, which is absent from the offline algorithms (SFT and offline DPO) studied by Ren and Sutherland (2025) . Its supervision is also dense and token-level and can be disconnected from the reasoning outcome (such as accuracy), whereas RL gives only sparse, outcome-level learning signals.
blocks.zh: 内核反应法. 神经正核连接了参数学习功能-空间变化(Jacot等,2018年). Malladi等 (2023)通过内核分析语言模型微调,包括亚当扩展;Ren和Sutherland (2025)通过常态分解预测变化,经验内核,以及SFT和偏好微调的减级条件,包括下线 DPO. Tomihari(2026)研究更新了RL培训后的传播。 由于两个原因,OPD需要不同的理论和经验机制. 它的"政策抽样"移动了学习分布本身,因此分析必须跟踪这一运动,这在Ren和Sutherland(2025年)研究的离线算法(SFT和离线DPO)中是没有的. 其监督也密集而有象征意义,可能与推理结果脱节(如准确性),而RL只给出少量的成果级学习信号.

blocks.en: Nevertheless, the fundamental response law of the shared-parameter neural learner is shared with Ren and Sutherland (2025) . We then follow the induced motion through the rest of the OPD loop: changes at ancestor decisions alter reach probabilities, renew the training source, and thereby change the requests driving future updates. Combining the evolving kernel, routing/drift split, and continuation-value analysis yields a mechanistic account of how optimization changes future supervision and outcomes ( Sections 3 and C ).
blocks.zh: 尽管如此,共享参数神经学习者的基本反应定律与Ren和Sutherland(2025)共享. 然后我们通过 OPD 循环的其余部分跟踪被诱导的运动: 祖先决定的改变会改变达到概率, 更新训练源,从而改变驱动未来更新的请求. 结合不断发展的内核,路由/驱动分解,以及续作价值分析,得出了优化如何改变未来监督和结果的机械化说法(第3和C节.

blocks.en: Cumulative weight geometry vs the geometry of request conversion. Shen et al. (2026) find low stable rank and early stabilization of dominant subspaces in cumulative weight-matrix changes; constrained-training experiments test those subspaces’ functional sufficiency. We instead analyze the current logit Jacobian and the response it delivers to specified teacher requests. The Jacobian can change even when cumulative displacement is low-rank. Frozen histories, coordinates, and requests isolate amplification and reorientation; crossed teacher fields test preferential adaptation in the same kernel ( Sections C.4 and D.5 ). Distinguishing local accessibility from collective coherence further explains why individually expressible requests can cancel. These analyses concern how geometry enables or obstructs transfer.
blocks.zh: 累积重几何与请求转换的几何. Shen等人(2026年)发现,在累积的重量矩阵变化中,占优势的子空间处于低平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平 相反,我们分析目前的逻辑雅各比亚语,以及它对特定教师要求的反应。 雅各比亚人即使累积的流离失所程度低,也可以改变. 冻结历史、坐标和要求隔离放大和调整方向;跨越教师领域在同一内核测试优先适应(C.4和D.5节)。 将地方无障碍与集体一致性区分开来,进一步解释了个人可表达的请求为何可以取消。 这些分析涉及几何学如何促成或阻碍转让。

blocks.en: Local fitting vs task performance. Policy-gradient theory ( Sutton et al., 1999 ) and cost-to-go-aware imitation learning ( Ross and Bagnell, 2014 ) connect actions to subsequent outcomes. G-OPD interprets distillation through KL-constrained RL and reward extrapolation ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . Armandpour et al. (2026) use student continuation-success probabilities to derive an ideal local logit direction and measure its alignment with distillation signals (however, they acknowledge that such estimations in long-CoT reasoning can be very noisy). Uemura and Suzuki (2026) theoretically studies the dynamics of self-distillation for a single-layer neural network, and analyzes how the supervision affects long-horizon traversal of directed acyclic graphs, invoking tools such as future advantage in their analysis. Our analysis connects this type of outcome perspective to delivered motion: ∑ s K t ​ ( x , s ) ​ Γ t ​ ( s ) \sum_{s}K_{t}(x,s)\Gamma_{t}(s) includes the effects of all coupled source prefixes in addition to the request at x x . Crucially, prefix readouts 𝔼 ν t ​ Y t ​ ( x ) \mathbb{E}_{\nu_{t}}Y_{t}(x) and terminal outcomes 𝔼 Π t ​ Y \mathbb{E}_{\Pi_{t}}Y are different objects. At an intermediate cut-position in the autoregressive rollout, terminal change splits into the change in reaching that prefix and the change in the continuations; unrolling the latter and recombining both terms yields the advantage-weighted contribution of every decision ( Equations 9 and C.8 ). This separates reaching a prefix, fitting there, and completing it successfully –the distinction underlying the degeneration mechanism and continuation readiness.
blocks.zh: 本地装配与任务性能 。 政策分级理论(Sutton等,1999年)和成本与意识相仿学习(Ross和Bagnell,2014年)将行动与随后的结果联系起来. G-OPD通过KL受限的RL和奖励外推法来解释蒸馏(杨等,2026. Armandpour等人(2026年)利用学生续作-成功概率得出理想的局部对数方向并测量其与蒸馏信号的相接性(然而,他们承认在长CoT推理中这种估计可能非常吵). 上村和铃木(2026年)在理论上研究了单层神经网络自沉的动力学,并分析监督如何影响定向回旋图的长视距穿行,在分析中引用了未来优势等工具. 我们的分析将这种结果视角与交付的运动联系起来: \ s K t (x, s) = = t ( s)\ sum } (x, s)\ Gamma_{t} (s) 包含xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx. 关键是,前缀读出 E { t Y t (x )\ mathbb{ E}_{\nu_{t}} Y_{t}(x)和终端结果 EΠ t Y\mathbb{ E}_{\Pi_{t}}Y}}Y是不同的对象. 在自动递减式推出的中间切入位置上,终端改变会分裂成达到前缀的改变和续作的改变;解除后缀并重新组合这两个术语会产生每个决定的优势加权贡献(第9和C.8等). 这分别是达到前缀、装配和成功完成 — — 衰变机制和持续准备的区别。

blocks.en: Degeneration involves source feedback as well as supervision quality. Fu et al. (2026) study unreliable supervision and implementation choices; Jin et al. (2026a) augment high-entropy teacher supervision with forward KL; and Zhu et al. (2026) analyze signals induced by top- K K truncation, renormalization, and stop-gradient conventions. Li et al. (2026b) also observe deterioration with prefix depth. Contemporaneous work by Wang et al. (2026) studies teacher mismatch and length exploitation. Our first-principled analysis reveals a phased failure mechanism: early routing makes already-uncertain continuations prevalent, after which substantial fitting can sharpen those very histories without restoring useful generation ( Sections E.3 and E.3.1 ). Our routing-drift machinery, coupled with the learning-value decomposition (for terminal-accuracy readout) distinguish the failure mechanism from a naive, uniform entropy-increasing learning process. The important feedback is that the histories made common by earlier updates become the source of later supervision. The prepared learner’s different trajectory further shows why source movement itself is not synonymous with failure, and its continuation-readiness helps in exposing useful subsequent learning.
blocks.zh: 退化涉及来源反馈以及监督质量。 Fu等人(2026年)研究不可靠的监督和执行选择;Jin等人(2026年a)用前方KL增强高强度的教师监督;和Zhu等人. (2026)分析由上-K K调速所诱发的信号,再正态化,和停止分级的常规. 李等 (2026b)也观测到有前缀深度的恶化. 王等同时期工作 (2026)研究教师不匹配和长度剥削. 我们的第一种原则性分析揭示出一种分阶段的失败机制:早期的路由使已经不确定的延续变得普遍,在此之后,实质性的适应性可以使这些历史更加清晰,而不恢复有用的一代(E.3和E.3.1节)。 我们的通路-驱动机械,加上学习-值分解(用于终端-精确读取),将故障机理与天真,统一的 en增生学习过程区分开来. 重要的反馈是,早期更新所共同形成的历史成为后期监督的来源. 准备学习者的不同轨迹进一步表明源流运动本身为何不是失败同义词,其持续准备有助于揭示有用的后续学习。

blocks.en: Offline preparation can improve readiness for learning without improving immediate accuracy. Li et al. (2026b) motivate cold-start SFT by reducing thinking-pattern mismatch and improving overlap. Their §5.1/Figure 8 studies a strong standalone-SFT regime: the SFT initialization already exceeds the direct-OPD endpoint on all three plotted benchmarks, with little further gains from OPD. We study a different regime, where the student-teacher gap is significant, and preparation leaves starting accuracy near the unprepared student’s but changes subsequent OPD from deterioration to substantial improvement. The principled motivation is continuation readiness : the outcome analysis and observed failure mechanisms in Section 3.3 identify a distinction between increasing a history’s reach and executing its continuation successfully. Teacher-generated trajectories provide training on such histories before the student must reach them itself. Our dose study exposes deferred benefits and a sharply nonmonotonic stability pattern at 7B; the prepared-run analysis traces a different subsequent routing/fitting process ( Tables 14 and E.5 ).
blocks.zh: 离线准备可以改善学习准备,而无需立即提高准确性。 Li等 (2026b)通过减少思维-模式不匹配并改进重叠来激励冷起 SFT. 他们的§5.1/图8研究了一个很强的独立-SFT制度:SFT的初始化已经超过了所有三个图定基准上的直接OPD终点,从OPD中几乎没有进一步的收益. 我们研究的是另一种制度,即学生与教师的差距很大,而准备的精准程度则接近于未准备好的学生,但随后的OPD从恶化转变为大幅度的改善。 原则动机是继续准备:结果分析和第3.3节所观察到的失败机制确定了增加历史影响与成功地实施历史延续之间的区别。 教师创造的轨迹在学生必须接触自己之前提供这类历史的培训。 我们的剂量研究暴露出7B的延迟效益和强烈的非通量稳定性模式;所准备的分析跟踪了随后不同的通由/适应过程(表14和E.5)。

blocks.en: In contemporaneous work Simple-OPD ( Liu et al., 2026 ) studies warm-up data, duration, and LoRA parameterization, including benefits from incorrect teacher-compatible traces and differences between SFT and downstream rankings. These findings complement our mechanistic account linking preparation to source feedback and continuation values. The key result is an altered learning trajectory; the preparation dose-response experiments demonstrate this interesting benefit.
blocks.zh: 在同时期的工作"简单-OPD"(Liu等,2026年)中,研究了取暖数据,持续时间,和LORA参数化,包括错误的教师相容痕迹和SFT与下游排名的差异所带来的好处. 这些调查结果补充了我们的机械账户,将编制与源反馈和延续值联系起来。 关键结果是学习轨迹的改变;准备剂量反应实验证明了这种有趣的好处。

blocks.en: B.2 More related works
blocks.zh: B.2 更多相关作品

blocks.en: Reasoning interpretability . Part of the focus of our work is on how LLMs learn to reason (from a teacher model), and our analysis methodology is partly inspired by the discoveries in the reasoning interpretability community. Venhoff et al. (2025a) is especially relevant, as they discovered that RL-trained models tend to acquire the ability to manage “when” to fire a reasoning mechanism (be it an “epistemic control” mechanism such as backtracking or planning, or computation mechanisms like estimating an inequality); Marjanovic et al. (2026) directly studies the chain-of-thought reasoning mechanisms of DeepSeek-R1 models, which our DeepSeek student models are distilled from, also inspiring our analysis on the epistemic control transmission in OPD. More broadly, Bogdan et al. (2025) ; Baek and Tegmark (2025) ; Venhoff et al. (2025b) ; Troitskii et al. (2025) ; Hong et al. (2025) ; Ward et al. (2025) identify causal mechanisms behind LLMs’ reasoning behaviors in logic, mathematics and other related domains.
blocks.zh: 合理解释性. 我们工作的一部分重点是LLMs如何学习理性(从教师模式),我们的分析方法部分受到推理解释界发现的启发. Venhoff等人(2025a)尤其相关,因为他们发现经过RL训练的模型往往获得“何时”发射推理机制的能力(无论是回溯跟踪或规划等“流行病学控制”机制,还是估计不平等等计算机制);Marjanovic等人(2026)直接研究了DeepSeek-R1模型的思维链推理机制,我们的DeepSeek学生模型是从中提炼出来的,这也激励了我们对OPD中流行病学控制传输的分析。 更广泛地说,Bogdan等人(2025年);Baek和Tegmark(2025年);Venhoff等人(2025年b);Troitskii等人(2025年);Hong等人(2025年);Ward等人。 (2025)识别LLMs在逻辑,数学和其他相关领域的推理行为背后的因果机制.

blocks.en: OPD and its variants . On-policy distillation is becoming increasingly popular in industry post-training pipelines ( DeepSeek-AI et al., 2026 ; Team et al., 2026 ) . Many variants are being proposed, including selecting which tokens to perform supervision on ( Jin et al., 2026b ; Yu et al., 2026 ) , and curriculum-styled variants ( Ziheng et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ) . The survey on OPD Song and Zheng (2026b) is also a good reference for understanding the research landscape in this area.
blocks.zh: OPD及其变种 . 在工业培训后管道中,政策蒸馏越来越受欢迎(DeepSeek-AI等,2026;Team等,2026)。 (jin等人,2026年b; Yu等, 2026 ),和课程类变体(Ziheng等, 2026;Zhang等, 2026;Li等, 2026a.). 关于OPD Song和Zheng的调查(2026b)也是了解该领域研究地貌的好参考.

blocks.en: Learning dynamics . Many classic works lie in this space and are predecessors to recent studies of LLM learning dynamics. Biehl and Schwarze (1995) ; Saad and Solla (1995) ; Saxe et al. (2014) ; Goldt et al. (2019) are early representative works, studying how learning trajectories and generalization depend on the model, initialization, and training process, and providing foundations for our analysis of how teacher supervision changes the student over time. Furthermore, a particular line of work study feature learning in nonlinear neural networks: Baratin et al. (2021) ; Atanasov et al. (2022) ; Hong et al. (2024) ; Allen-Zhu and Li (2022) ; Allen-Zhu and Li (2023a) study how the nonlinear neural network’s geometry evolves and aligns with the task, showing feature re-orientation early on in (pre-)training that precedes appreciable loss reduction (sometimes called the “lottery winning” phase, where certain neurons or features better align towards loss-reducing directions early in training without substantial loss-reduction yet). These works are especially relevant to our analysis of the student’s changing responsiveness to teacher requests in Section 3.2 , and to offline preparation whose benefits become apparent through subsequent learning. Additionally, another relevant line of work in the pre-LLM era study dynamics of DNN distillation. Phuong and Lampert (2019) ; Ji and Zhu (2020) ; Hong et al. (2021) ; Allen-Zhu and Li (2023b) ; Panahi et al. (2022) ; He and Ozay (2022) examine how the geometry of the learning problem, teacher knowledge, and the student’s representation affect transfer, using linear, deep linear, or kernel-based analyses of the SGD-based learning trajectory.
blocks.zh: 学习动力学. 许多经典作品都位于这个空间,是最近研究LLM学习动力学的前身. Biehl和Schwarze(1995年);Saad和Solla(1995年);Saxe等人(2014年);Goldt等人(2019年)是早期的代表性作品,研究学习轨迹和通俗化如何取决于模式、初始化和培训过程,并为我们分析教师监督如何随着时间的推移改变学生提供了基础。 此外,一项特别的工作研究是在非线性神经网络中学习:Baratin等人(2021年);Atanasov等人(2022年);Hong等人(2024年);Allen-Zhu和Li(2022年);Allen-Zhu和Li(2023年a年)研究非线性神经网络的几何学如何演变并配合任务,在显著减少损失之前(有时称为 " 输液取胜 " 阶段)的(前)培训中显示特征的早期方向调整,在培训初期某些神经元或特征更好地与减少损失方向保持一致,而未大幅度地减少损失)。 这些作品特别有助于我们分析学生对第3.2节中教师要求的反应变化,也有利于通过随后的学习而明显受益的离线准备。 此外,LLM时代前研究DNN蒸馏动力学的又一相关工作领域. Phuong and Lampert (2019); Ji and Zhu (2020); Hong等 (2021); Allen-Zhu and Li (2023b); Panahi等 (2022); He and Ozay (2022) 考察学习问题的几何,教师知识,以及学生的表达方式如何影响转移,使用线性,深线性,或基于内核的分析SGD的学习轨迹.

blocks.en: The path limit is a population statement; finite-sample differences between empirical banks, checkpoint substitutions, prompt-composition changes, and support-switch jumps lie outside it, and Sections E.1 and E.6 give the corresponding experimental controls. At a fixed finite partition the allocation is a symmetric endpoint convention.
blocks.zh: 路径限制是一个人口表;经验库,检查站替代,即时分解变化,支持-开关跳跃之间的有限-样本差异位于它之外,而E.1和E.6节给出了相应的实验控制. 在固定的有限分区中,分配是一个对称的终点公约。

blocks.en: This appendix gives the experimental details behind Section 3.2 . We first describe the model pairs and the fixed prefixes used for measurement. We then ask where the teachers place their strongest requests, how well those requests produce parameter updates, and how the student’s responsiveness changes during training. The derivations are in Sections C.3 and C.4 .

blocks.en: LLM Judge Prompt You are annotating every sentence of a model’s reasoning trace (for example, a model solving a math problem) with a label describing the act the sentence performs. REASONING TRACE: "{reasoning_trace}" Emit per sentence: {"sent_idx": int, "fine": [1 label], "uncertain": bool, "note": "..."} Read the FULL trace first; judge each sentence’s FUNCTION IN CONTEXT. ## Fine labels CONTROL family (steering the reasoning process): - check-initiate: starting a verification act on ALREADY-ESTABLISHED material -- re-computing a prior result, re-reading the problem statement, re-deriving an earlier step. First-time testing of a fresh candidate or case is NOT check-initiate (see TECHNICAL). - check-conclude: verdict closing a check episode. Covers: work-correctness verdicts ("Yes, that’s correct", "that step was wrong"); verdicts about the check itself, including redundancy ("I already did this case", "we’ve already considered that"); resolutions of a problem re-read that settle interpretation ("So it’s allowed to be prime"). - doubt-flag: hesitation OR bare deliberation cue WITHOUT an act ("Wait.", "Hmm, that seems too big.", "Let me think.", "Let’s see."). Judged sentence-locally: a bare cue stays doubt-flag even when a check follows in the next sentence. Never label bare cues as plan. - plan: stating an approach or opening a new sub-task, with the approach/task STATED ("I’ll use coordinates", new-sub-task colon lead-ins like "Compute the exponent:"). Includes proceed-decisions ("Let me try that"). - reframe: abandoning/switching approach. NOT routine next-case moves in an enumeration ("Alternatively, x=2" = TECHNICAL). - repair: announcing/making a correction of an earlier error. - recap: MULTI-ITEM consolidation of established state used to steer. Single value-echoes = compute/derive. - commit: FINAL-ANSWER commitment only ("So the answer is 34", "Answer: 34"). TECHNICAL family (object-level mathematics): - derive: algebraic/logical derivation steps; this includes stating the associated problem facts, notation, coordinates, case setup, and within-computation connective lead-ins (including "Simplify:", "Comparing coefficients:"). - recall: invoking a theorem/definition/known mathematical fact. OTHER family: - style: pure filler/transition with no content and no steering. - format: formatting artifacts, the end-of-reasoning marker (e.g. </think>), bare list numerals or LaTeX delimiters split onto their own lines (format, not fragment). - unclear: genuinely unclassifiable. ## Fixed vocabulary and note rules Use only the labels above; do not propose or introduce new labels. A sentence the rules do not settle or hard to classify takes the best available existing label, "uncertain": true, and leave a short note -- residual uncertainty is data itself, please do not treat it as a defect to legislate away. Furthermore, write in the note for the sentence if it genuinely has more than one of the labels above.

blocks.en: This appendix gives the experimental details for Section 3.3 . We examine how OPD changes prefix visitation and the student’s predictions on fixed prefixes. We then ask whether the student can complete its reasoning from those prefixes and reach a correct answer. The theoretical backbone is derived and presented in Sections C.5 , C.6 , C.7 , C.8 and C.9 .

blocks.en: All three learners use JustRL-1.5B as the teacher. The strong learner is DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B which we also studied in Section 3.2 . blocks.en: E.2 DeepSeek: adjusting the probability of checking
blocks.zh: E.2 DeepSeek:调整检查概率

blocks.en: DeepSeek’s local loss falls mainly because its predictions change at fixed prefixes ( Table 6 ). We next ask whether these changes bring its checking probabilities closer to the teacher’s, as“wait”-initiated checking / backtracking is a dominant part of the model’s reasoning traces and observed to initiate sentences in which the model manage its epistemic states ( Marjanovic et al., 2026 ) . We use the classes in Section E.1 , defined by whether the reference student’s WAIT probability lies above or below the teacher’s.

blocks.en: We now examine prefixes at which the initial student was about to answer. Holding these prefixes fixed lets us ask two questions: how does training change the probability of answering now, and how successful are the continuations from the two alternatives? This comparison isolates changes at the selected prefixes from changes in prefix visitation.

blocks.en: We sample two rollouts per problem from the initial student on 50 held-out MATH-500 problems. “Cutting” the rollout immediately before a final-answer marker ( \boxed or Answer: ) gives 86 prefixes. We evaluate the initial student, checkpoints 20–200 of the unprepared run, and the JustRL teacher on these same prefixes. For each model, we record the next-token probability mass π \pi on the probe’s answer class.

blocks.en: We draw six continuations per prefix under each of three conditions : the answer condition forces the answer token, the “continue” condition forces the model’s most probable non-answer token, and the “natural” condition samples without forcing either token. All conditions use temperature 0.6 0.6 , top- p = 0.95 p=0.95 , and a cap of 16,384 16{,}384 new tokens. Table 8 reports the fraction of correct continuations.

blocks.en: Let Q ans Q_{\rm ans} and Q cont Q_{\rm cont} denote the correctness values of the two forced branches, “answer” vs “continue” (recall that Q Q denotes the continuation success rate from the given prefix distribution after forcing an action choice). The early shift toward continuing is therefore not yet accompanied by lower continuation success on these prefixes.

blocks.en: The teacher also favors continuing over answering on these prefixes. Its continue branch, however, is more successful than its answer branch ( 0.58 0.58 versus 0.42 0.42 ), and its natural continuations succeed with probability 0.60 0.60 . This illustrates the role of continuation values in Equation 9 . In the probability term, a shift toward continuing helps when continuing is more successful than answering now. These answer-boundary probes examine that relation on fixed prefixes. Section E.7 then uses fixed reference continuers to examine changes in prefix visitation.

blocks.en: E.5 Prepared Qwen: how checking changes during training
blocks.zh: E.5 编写文:如何检查培训期间的变化

blocks.en: The prepared run improves its held-out score, even though its rollouts change markedly early in training. We first examine the order of these changes. We then ask whether the later decrease in checking also occurs on unchanged prefixes, how the teacher’s requests change, and which representative “calibration errors” remain.
blocks.zh: 尽管培训初期的推出情况有明显变化,但已准备好的运行提高了其搁置分数。 我们首先审查这些变化的顺序。 然后,我们问后来的检查减少是否也发生在没有改变的前缀上,教师的要求如何改变,以及哪些代表性的 " 校正错误 " 仍然存在。

blocks.en: Entropy rises early on. At step 20, entropy increases from 2.17 2.17 to 4.33 4.33 nats. Routing contributes + 1.98 +1.98 and drift + 0.18 +0.18 , while local loss falls from 0.707 0.707 to 0.173 0.173 . In the next comparison, from batch 21 to batch 41, loss overshoots to 0.437 0.437 . Its routing contribution is + 0.363 +0.363 and its drift contribution − 0.099 -0.099 . Entropy on batch 41 is already low (about 0.70 0.70 nats), and remains low (about 0.6 0.6 – 0.9 0.9 ) on later batches. Thus the loss overshoot follows the initial entropy rise. It mainly reflects a change in prefix visitation, similar to the early phase of the unprepared run.

blocks.en: E.7 Fixed-reference continuation experiments
blocks.zh: E.7 固定参照继续试验

blocks.en: The answer-versus-continue experiment in Section E.4 conducted a case study probing continuation from fixed prefixes. This, however, is not enough in understanding the decline in terminal score of the trained student model. Recall that, at a high level, the broadcast not only affects continuation behaviors of the model, but also changes its prefix visitation probabilities. Therefore, to understand the terminal-score decline during OPD, we must also consider how the prefixes that the student checkpoints generates as training proceeds. At any rollout depth, successful completion depends on two quantities: which prefixes the student reaches, and how successfully it continues from those prefixes. We first express terminal score in terms of these two quantities, then show how the reference-policy experiment separates their changes.
blocks.zh: E.4节中的答案与持续实验进行了一项案例研究,从固定前缀中检测续作. 然而,这不足以理解训练有素的学生模式的末期分数下降. 回顾在高水平上,广播不仅会影响模型的延续行为,还会改变其前缀访问概率. 因此,为了了解在OPD期间终点分数下降的情况,我们还必须考虑学生检查站在培训过程中如何产生前缀。 在任何展开深度,成功完成取决于两个数量:学生到达的哪个前缀,以及从这些前缀继续成功的程度. 我们首先用这两个量来表示终端分数,然后显示参考政策实验如何区分它们的变化.

The readout is extracted-answer success on the full prefix and continuation; the answer need not be immediately followed by an end-of-turn token. Stopping is recorded separately. The estimator averages continuation scores within each prefix, then over the two source rollouts and uniformly over problems, retaining earlier completed responses as above. This population and budget differ from those of the selected answer-boundary probe in Section E.4 . The reported values below are rounded sample means; independently sampled self-continuations estimate the same J Y ​ ( t ) J_{Y}(t) but need not give identical means at different cuts.

blocks.en:
Another interesting question is, at a fixed checkpoint t t , moving the rollout cut from h 1 h_{1} to h 2 h_{2} lets the trained student generate an additional block of tokens before the initial student takes over. blocks.en: Appendix F Preparation: protocols and additional measurements
blocks.zh: 附录F 准备:协议和补充测量

blocks.en: F.1 Three-family AIME comparison
blocks.zh: F.1 三个家庭的AIME比较

blocks.en: The pairs are Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct / JustRL-1.5B, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct / AceReason-Nemotron-7B, and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct / Llama-3.1-Nemotron-Nano-8B-v1. Each pair shares a tokenizer vocabulary. The fixed teacher supplies the preparation text, the offline-control targets, and the on-policy log-probabilities. The Llama teacher uses its reasoning mode with the system prompt “detailed thinking on.”
blocks.zh: 配对有: Quen2.5-1.5B-教程 / JustRL-1.5B; Quen2.5-7B-教程 / Acereason-Nemotron-7B; 和 Llama-3.1-8B-教程 / Llama-3.1-Nemotron-Nano-8B-v1. 每对都共享一个标语词汇. 固定教师提供准备文本,离线控制目标,以及政策日志概率. Llama 老师使用其推理模式,

blocks.en: Each teacher generates solutions to problems drawn from OpenMathInstruct-2 ( Toshniwal et al., 2024 ) , at temperature one with an 8,192-token response cap. The student uses token-level forward KL on the teacher’s recorded top-16 next-token support. The plotted cold start uses 512 optimizer steps of 256 sequences, or 131,072 sequence presentations. The Qwen 1.5B, 7B and Llama corpora each contain 32,768 teacher solutions, so this is four corpus sweeps.
blocks.zh: 每个老师都生成OpenMathInstruct-2(Toshniwal等,2024年)所引出问题的解决方案,温度一为8,192-托肯响应上限. 学生在老师记录的前16名下台支持上使用符号级前置KL. 所绘制的冷起取用256个序列的512个优化步骤,即131,072个序列演示. Quen 1.5B, 7B和Llama corpora各包含32,768个师资解决方案,因此这是4个官能团扫描.

blocks.en: The offline settings are AdamW, learning rate 10 − 6 10^{-6} , momentum coefficients ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) (0.9,0.95) , no weight decay, gradient clipping at 1.0. The cold-start sequence limit is 8,192 tokens.
blocks.zh: 离线设置为:AdamW,学习率10−6 10^{-6},动力系数(0.9,0.95)(0.9,0.95),不减重,梯度剪接为1.0. 冷起序限为8,192个符.

blocks.en: The prompt pool is DAPO-Math-17k ( Yu et al., 2025 ) , recorded as 17,398 unique problems. Training uses consecutive blocks of 6,400 rows in the released ordering. Each block contains 6,235–6,318 unique problems.
blocks.zh: 即时池为DAPO-Math-17k(Yu等,2025年),记录为17,398个特有问题. 训练在发布的订单中连续使用6400行的块. 每个区块包含6,235–6,318个独特的问题.

blocks.en: OPD samples four student responses for each of 64 prompts per step, giving 256 responses and one optimizer step per update. Sampling is at temperature one, capped at 8,192 tokens for Qwen and 14,336 for Llama.
blocks.zh: OPD对每步64个提示中的每个给出4个学生响应进行抽样,每次更新给出256个响应和一个优化步骤. 采样在一号温度下,为昆文的8,192个令牌封顶,拉玛为14,336个.

blocks.en: The offline continuation instead uses four teacher-generated solutions for each prompt row in the same blocks: 25,600 sequences per 6,400-row block. It uses the teacher forward-KL objective and optimizer settings as preparation, at 256 sequences per step. The sequence limits are 8,192 for Qwen and 15,360 for Llama, the latter retaining the reported teacher solutions generated with a 14,336-token response cap. Thus the comparison matches the implemented offline and on-policy recipes in prompt blocks, sequence counts, and total optimizer steps.
blocks.zh: 离线续作取而代之的是使用四个由师生生成的解决方案,用于同一块中每个快行:每6400行块25600个序列. 它使用教师前方-KL的客观和优化设置作为准备,每步256个序列. Quen的序列限制为8,192个,Llama的序列限制为15,360个,后者保留了报告的教师溶液生成的14,336个托肯响应上限. 因此,比较与在快速区块、顺序计数和总体优化步骤中实施的离线和政策配方相匹配。

blocks.en: Table 11: Comparison budgets from the same prepared checkpoint within each model pair, after 512 OMI2 preparation steps. Sequence presentations include repetitions.
blocks.zh: 表11:经过512个OMI2准备步骤之后,每个模型对内同一准备的检查站的预算比较。 序列介绍包括重复.

blocks.en: The evaluation pools AIME 2024 and 2025, 30 problems each. Each checkpoint is evaluated using 32 responses per problem from the first sampling batch (batch a), with vLLM, the student’s template, temperature 0.6 0.6 , top- p = 0.95 p=0.95 , and a 16,384-new-token cap. Scoring is lenient: answer extraction uses a boxed answer when present, otherwise an explicit answer marker including “the answer is”.
blocks.zh: 评价汇集了AIME 2024和2025,各30个问题. 每个检查点都使用第一批抽样(批次a)中每个问题的32个答复进行评估,其中VLLM,学生的模板,温度为0.6 0.6,顶-p=0.95 p=0.95,并有16,384个新托顶. 分红是宽大处理的:解答取出在出现时使用框式解答,否则就使用包括“解答是”在内的明确解答标记。

(2021) , if c i c_{i} of the 32 responses solve problem i i , we estimate pass ​ @ ​ k ^ = 1 60 ​ ∑ i = 1 60 [ 1 − ( 32 − c i k ) ( 32 k ) ] , 1 ≤ k ≤ 32 , \widehat{\mathrm{pass@}k}=\frac{1}{60}\sum_{i=1}^{60}\left[1-\frac{\binom{32-c_{i}}{k}}{\binom{32}{k}}\right],\qquad 1\leq k\leq 32, (29) with a zero numerator when 32 − c i < k 32-c_{i}<k .
