blocks.en: Table 12 gives the pooled pass@ k k endpoints and the number of problems at each empirical reliability threshold.
blocks.zh: 表12给出了集合通关@ kk端点和每个经验可靠性阈值上的问题数量.

blocks.en: Table 12: Pooled AIME endpoints and observed reliability at 32 samples per problem (batch a). Coverage, at-least-half, and all-32 columns count problems out of 60. Both Llama comparison arms start from the same prepared checkpoint and use the budgets in Table 11 .
blocks.zh: 表12:每个问题32个样本的集成AIME端点和观察到的可靠性(批次a)。 在60个栏目中,覆盖率至少为一半,全部为32个栏目。 与Llama相比,这两个武器都从同一个检查站开始,并使用表11中的预算。

blocks.en: Among problems solved at least once by both the OPD and offline endpoints, mean observed success rates (OPD/offline) are 0.281 / 0.104 0.281/0.104 for Qwen 1.5B (3 problems), 0.599 / 0.455 0.599/0.455 for Qwen 7B (25), and 0.264 / 0.159 0.264/0.159 for Llama (13). These intersections are selected using both arms’ samples, so their means are descriptive. Against the offline endpoint, OPD gains coverage on 8, 11, and 8 problems and loses it on 2, 1, and 1, respectively.
blocks.zh: 在通过业务发展办公室和离线终点至少解决一次的问题中,观测到的平均成功率(OPD/离线)为0.281/0.104。 Quen 1.5B(3个问题),0.599/0.455 Wen 7B(25个)0.599/0.455,Llama(13个)0.264/0.159。 这些相交点是使用两种武器样品选定的,因此它们的手段是描述性的。 相对于离线终点,OPD分别在8,11和8个问题上获得覆盖,并在2,1和1上失去覆盖.

blocks.en: For each student and year, we resample the 30 problem indices with replacement, keeping the OPD and offline outcomes paired. For pass@1 the per-problem difference is ( c i OPD − c i offline ) / 32 (c_{i}^{\mathrm{OPD}}-c_{i}^{\mathrm{offline}})/32 ; for pass@32 it is 𝟏 { c i OPD > 0 } − 𝟏 { c i offline > 0 } \mathbf{1}\{c_{i}^{\mathrm{OPD}}>0\}-\mathbf{1}\{c_{i}^{\mathrm{offline}}>0\} . Table 13 reports the mean difference and the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of its exact conditional bootstrap distribution, computed by convolution of the empirical per-problem difference distribution. This avoids Monte Carlo error in the interval endpoints. The intervals quantify problem-resampling uncertainty conditional on the checkpoints and recorded outcomes.
blocks.zh: 对于每个学生和年度,我们用替换来重现30个问题指数,保持OPD和离线结果对接. 对于通过@1,每个问题的差异是(ci OPD - ci 离线)/ 32(c_{i}^{\-mathrm{OPD}}-c_{i}^{\-mathrm{offline}})/32;对于通过@32,是 1 {ci OPD > 0 } - 1 { c i 离线 > 0 }\ mathbf{1}\{c_{i}^{\mathrm{OPD}}>0\}-\mathbf{1}\{c_{i}^{\mathrm{offline}}>0\}. 表13按每个问题的经验差异分布的演化计算,报告平均差异及其确切有条件的靴子分布的2.5和97.5百分位数。 这避免了蒙特卡洛在间隔终点出错. 时间间隔以检查点和记录结果为条件,量化问题复制不确定性。

blocks.en: Table 13: OPD minus offline control at 32 samples per problem (batch a), with 95% paired problem-bootstrap percentile intervals computed separately within each year. Values are in probability units.
blocks.zh: 表13:OPD减去每问题32个样本的离线控制(批次a),95%的配对问题-陷阱百分位间隔每年分别计算。 值为概率单位.

blocks.en: F.2 Preparation-dose study
blocks.zh: F.2 制剂-剂量研究

blocks.en: We follow the same preparation (cold start) procedure as before, except we vary the number of passes over the cold-start corpus and study subsequent OPD performance. Evaluation uses the first 250 MATH-500 problems, four responses per problem, temperature 0.6 0.6 , top- p = 0.95 p=0.95 , a 16,384-new-token cap, and the deployment template. Table 14 reports strict pass@1 and 95% problem-bootstrap intervals with 2,000 resamples.
blocks.zh: 我们和以前一样遵循同样的准备(冷启动)程序,除非我们改变冷启动程序通过的次数,并研究随后的OPD性能. 评价采用前250个MATH-500问题,每问题4个响应,温度0.6 0.6,上-p=0.95 p=0.95,出自16,384个新托顶盖,部署模板. 表14报告严格通过@1和95%的问题-陷阱间隔,有2,000个复标。

blocks.en: The 1.5B OPD series uses the step-100 checkpoint. The 7B series uses the best checkpoint evaluated every ten steps within the first 100 OPD steps: steps 30, 50, and 90 for one, two, and four preparation passes, respectively. Its intervals are computed at the selected checkpoint and do not adjust for checkpoint selection.
blocks.zh: 1.5B OPD系列使用步-100检查站. 7B系列在前100个OPD步骤中采用每10个步骤评价的最佳检查点:步骤30,50和90,分别为1个,2个和4个准备通行证. 检查间隔在选定的检查站计算,不作检查站选择调整。

blocks.en: Table 14: The dose panels of Figure 8 : strict MATH-500 pass@1 (first 250 problems, 4 samples per problem) after 1, 2 and 4 preparation passes. The OPD column uses step 100 at 1.5B and the best evaluated checkpoint within 100 steps at 7B. Brackets give 95% problem-bootstrap intervals at each checkpoint.
blocks.zh: 表14 图8的剂量面板:严格MATH-500通过@1(第一个250个问题,每个问题4个样本),经过1,2和4个制备. OPD一栏在1.5B使用第100步,在7B使用100步内使用得到最佳评价的检查站. 每个检查站都有95%的间隔。
